description: Public SDK methods kept for one more minor version after the API contract dropped them (docs/DESIGN.md section 3.1). Written by codegen/spec-sync.ts, keyed by resource.method. reason is removed (the operation left the contract or is no longer a server operation) or renamed (its x-didit-sdk naming changed; replacement names the new method). Each entry holds its operation with the component schemas it uses, so its types keep their names and nothing depends on the current documents. tests/contract.test.ts fails once the package version reaches remove_in: delete the entry and regenerate in that release.
